messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: geodns probe alert (APAC) - multiple resolver failures observed against Cloudflare egress from ap-southeast-1b. Probe failure rate 18% over 2m, error codes=NXDOMAIN+SERVFAIL. Paging oncall SRE (severity: high).
Rajesh Kumar: oncall here, ack. pulling metrics and routing table now. @Maya you free to triage?
Maya Patel: on it. seeing spike in DNS error rate for provider cf-egress-apac-1 in the last 90s. dashboards: https://redwood.internal/observability/dns?range=5m (link shared).
Maya Patel: quick sanity dig against a failing name:```
; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> +short www.customer-example.com @8.8.8.8
; (querying Cloudflare resolver chain via our probes)
;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached
```
Tony Li: I can repro from a cf edge internally — partial NXDOMAINs and TTLs dropping to 0 then back up. feels like inconsistent answers from Cloudflare authoritative layer or an upstream cache thrash.
Leah Gomez: any recent deploys to geodns or provider configs? I see a config rollout 2h ago for APAC weighting but it was canaryed.
Maya Patel: config looks unchanged in the last 3 hours. metrics show sharp divergence between our CF-governed egress and route53 fallback paths.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-17 (severity=high) assigned to #incidents and SRE oncall.
Rajesh Kumar: decision: initiate temporary provider priority flip for ap-southeast-1b -> prefer route53 for geo region to restore resolution consistency. I'll run the control-plane command. Standby for confirmation.
Maya Patel: copying runbook - emergency provider failover snippet:```
# promote route53 for APAC egress
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood/api/v1/geodns/regions/ap-southeast-1/providers/priority" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -d '{"priority": ["route53","cloudflare"]}'
```
Rajesh Kumar: executing now.```
$ curl -s -X POST "https://control.redwood/api/v1/geodns/regions/ap-southeast-1/providers/priority" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"priority":["route53","cloudflare"]}' && echo "ok"
ok
```
Erin Cole: notifying affected customers in APAC support queue (incidents@). drafting banner saying degraded DNS in APAC with mitigation in progress.
Maya Patel: rerunning probes. error rate dropping from 18% -> 2% over last 60s on ap-southeast-1b. latency also normalizing.
Leah Gomez: dig now returns expected A records and TTLs look stable:```
; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> +short www.customer-example.com @1.1.1.1
203.0.113.45
```
Tony Li: looks like path-level inconsistency: CF authoritative sometimes returning short or empty answers to our probes in that AZ. route53 answers consistent.
Maya Patel: re-evaluating whether to keep route53 preferred until CF confirms fix. Recommend keep until next maintenance window + follow up with CF support.
Rajesh Kumar: agreed. created temporary mitigation ticket MF-APAC-2026-04; I've pinned provider priority change and alerted CF customer support with packet captures and probe logs.
ops-bot: Pager duty note saved to INC-2026-0421-17.
Maya Patel: impact summary for status page: "Some customers in APAC experienced DNS lookup failures between 17:06 and 17:14 UTC due to inconsistent responses from an external DNS provider. We routed traffic to an alternate provider which mitigated user impact; resolution in progress." Thoughts before publishing?
Erin Cole: that's good — add that customer API traffic may have seen transient 5xxs as SDKs retried.
Leah Gomez: add note: TTL inconsistency may cause cache misses for longer tail clients, recommend keep mitigation for 2 hours then re-evaluate.
Rajesh Kumar: publishing status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0421-17 (drafted).
Maya Patel: post-mitigation checks: continuous probes show 0.5% error over last 10m. CPU/memory on geodns nodes unchanged. No evidence of internal regression.
Tony Li: CF responded: "Investigating edge config propagation causing stale delegations in ap-southeast-1b" — they flagged an internal rollout. asked for sample probe logs.
Maya Patel: attached sample probe log:```
2026-04-21T17:07:02Z probe-101 ap-southeast-1b CF_EGRESS NXDOMAIN "query_id=12345" latency=512ms
2026-04-21T17:07:03Z probe-102 ap-southeast-1b CF_EGRESS SERVFAIL "query_id=12346" latency=18ms
```
Rajesh Kumar: handoff to day SRE for follow-up (keeping route53 priority) — @Maya please include mitigation steps in incident ticket and confirm rollback plan.
Maya Patel: done. rollback plan: only rollback when CF confirms stable answers for >=30m and our probe error <0.5%. Steps: 1) revert provider priority via control-plane API 2) monitor probe health 3) communicate to support + ops.
ops-bot: Note added to incident: follow-up assigned to Maya Patel.
Leah Gomez: quick note for postmortem: add root cause hypothesis = external provider edge propagation anomaly leading to inconsistent authoritative answers; include timeline and remediation actions.
Erin Cole: sent communication to APAC customers who filed tickets; asked them to confirm if they still see failures.
Rajesh Kumar: closing active page — mitigation stable. Will keep incident open for post-incident review and vendor RCA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" (INC-2026-0421-17).
